# Recursive enum tokens and opaque map results

A Class<E> token retains E extends Enum<E> in one invariant result slot; the
other result slot is a fixed String key. Original calls preserve opaque map
identity, subclass dispatch, callback mutations, exact failures and delayed
value casts. Null and raw non-enum tokens remain untouched when the provider
does not inspect them; an unused enum must not initialize. Source and SDK paths
compile every emitted source and check all original definitions, roles,
Signature and Exceptions. Four frozen invocation paths run 192 fresh cases twice,
qualified by fifteen wrong programs and eight same-Code Signature controls.
